price.source: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint (unofficial, daily close)

cds.source: DTCC SEC public dissemination, end-of-day cumulative credit files
cds.method: On-the-run 5Y senior trades with a disclosed notional; quoted points = cash upfront + accrued; ISDA standard model, flat hazard, 40% recovery, discounting on the US Treasury par curve of the trade date. Daily median.

cds_5y_bp.label: 5-year CDS — reported in news
cds_5y_bp.note: No free automated feed. Values are hand-recorded from news reports that cite Markit or ICE data; they are secondary and may not be closing levels. 1,000 bp is commonly read as a credit-stress threshold.

points.note: Intraday record, ICE data as reported

bond_2032_9625_yield_pct.label: 9.625% notes due Jul 2032 — yield
bond_2032_9625_yield_pct.note: Hand-recorded from news reports; no free TRACE feed. Issued at 9.625% in June 2026.

points.note: About 79.5 cents on the dollar, as reported

active_power_mw.label: Active power
active_power_mw.note: Company-reported in quarterly earnings releases; definition (IT vs facility power) not stated.

undrawn_facilities_usd_bn.label: Undrawn committed facilities
undrawn_facilities_usd_bn.note: Revolver plus DDTL availability per 10-Q. DDTL amounts can only fund the specific financed contracts; only the revolver (about $2.0bn at 2026-06-30) is general purpose.

events.label: Q3 2026 results and conference call (5:00 pm ET)
